title: CS63061: Telemedicine
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction: What is Telemedicine? A historical perspective, Convergence of
different technologies and services.
Medical Information and Data: Representation, Acquisition, Presentation and
Communication, Transducer, Analog Signal, Band-width of a signal, Digital
Signal, Analog to Digital conversion, Quantization and Sampling, Encoding and
Decoding, ECG, EEG, EMG and Phono-cardiogram, Digital Images and Video, DICOM
standard, Image and Video compression: A brief introduction, Graphics Terminal
and display.
Fundamentals of Telecommunication: Signal, Channel, Channel Band-width,
Carrier modulation and demodulation, Amplitude, Frequency and Phase modulation,
Modulation of digital data: QAM, PSK, QPSK etc., Telephone line and modem,
Communication media: Co-axial, UTP and STP cables, Fiber Optics Cable, wireless
media, Satellite link, Mobile communication, Computer
Network: OSI
architecture, LAN and WAN. Protocols: Telnet, FTP, HTTP, TCP/IP, UDP/IP,
Ethernet, Network security: Firewall, private and public IP, Encryption of
digital data, public and private key encryption, digital
signature.
Health Care Management: Health care informatics: different components,
Telemedical Information system, Organizational Management of Telemedicine,
Implementation Barriers, HL7 standards, Security and Confidentiality.
Telemedicine case studies.
Evaluation and cost-benefit analysis of a telemedicine system.
Medico-legal aspects of national and international telemedicine.
